summary: The main results (integral representation, bound) are genuinely new — nothing in Mathlib, Physlib or TauCeti has spherical Bessel functions or Legendre polynomials in this sense. But three proof blocks re-derive material that already exists: the repo's own Cauchy–Schwarz lemma, Mathlib's `integral_exp_mul_I_eq_sinc`, and the Bonnet-against-a-weight lemma in Legendre/Basic.lean.
